name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
🗂️ Deep Google Drive Hierarchy: Supports up to 8 levels of nested subfolders and sub-subfolders with complete relative path names.
🚀 Fluid Unconstrained Scrolling: Removed touch-interception locks so entire playlist and subfolder trees scroll natively with momentum.
🎬 Batch Format Pill Carousel: Horizontal swipeable format pills (1080p, 720p, 480p, MP3) with intuitive UI guidance hint.
⏱️ Accurate Media Timelines: Fixed 00:00 duration bug across all items with real length probing and HD footage badges.
⚡ Adobe CEP Plugin Sync: Full deep-tree recursive scanning, corrected selection counts, and reliable batch downloads.
